parties.petitioner: Just Rights For Children Alliance & Anr.

summary: Child pornography; possession of videos depicting underage boys with adult woman; Section 15 POCSO; Section 67B IT Act; quashing by High Court reversed; statutory presumption under Section 30 POCSO valid; inchoate crime analysis; foundational facts for possession; ignorance of law no defense; criminal proceedings reinstated.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; criminal proceedings restored; case remanded to trial court.
